title: refactor(service-automation): move the run-context and resume bodies into run-resume.ts (#25222 slice 6)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCEzLkAB12FfRHL9ipwfKPd)_

Part of #25222
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

This is slice 6 of the `engine.ts` split, and its claim is comment 6377626691. The bodies of fifteen `AutomationEngine` methods move, unedited, into a new module, `packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`:

- `resolveRunContext`, `seedRunGrants`, `resolveDecisionSegmentContext` and `expandDeclaredLookups`, which resolve a run's context, grants and declared lookups;
- `resume`, `refuseGatedResume`, `refuseUndeclaredSuspension`, `loadSuspendedRun`, `loadSuspendedRunStrict` and `creditChildRun`, which load, gate and resume a suspended run;
- `failSuspendedRun`, `settleUnresumableSuspension`, `cancelRun`, `cloneVariablesAtPause` and `failAncestors`, which fail, settle or cancel a suspended run, along with its ancestors.

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for the later slices. The branch is `claude/project-thread-nirtwt`, which the harness pins for this session. It was restarted from `main` at `03243fc6` after slice 5 (#25551) merged. The branch name has no issue number, so the claim comment is the identity record.

## Scope

- **The 33-site question.** The ruling on the 33 `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` sites in 21 methods is still pending with Sales. This slice moves **0** of those sites, because none of the fifteen bodies holds one. `check-tenant-audit-census` and `check-system-context-census` give byte-identical output at base and head (see Readers).
- **Return types.** Each of the fifteen methods declares its return type, including the two public ones, `resume` and `cancelRun`. So no public body with an inferred return type moves.
- **None of the bodies that must stay moves.** The remaining-bodies table (comment 6376268510) marks these as stays:
  - for liveness, `retryExecution` and `getConnectorDescriptors`;
  - for private statics, `resolveCanonicalDescriptor`, `resolveResumeAuthority` and `resolveEffectiveSuspension`. `refuseGatedResume` and `refuseUndeclaredSuspension` call them through host closures, and they stay in the class;
  - for the startup-registry gate, `knownNodeTypes`, `getUnknownNodeTypeAudit`, `sealNodeTypeVocabulary` and `warnUnknownNodeTypes`.
- **Two more bodies stay: `refuseInvalidScreenInput` and `buildSubflowResumeSignal`.**
  - The table put them in this group. But they read `ENGINE_BUILT_SIGNAL` and `engineBuilt`, and `docs/adr/0019-approval-as-flow-node.md` calls that symbol "module-private".
  - Moving them would mean exporting both names from `engine.ts`. The package's export map is `.` only and `index.ts` would re-export neither, so the symbol would stay out of reach outside the package. Even so, the ADR's line would no longer be true.
  - So they stay in the class, as the claim says, and the table's stays are now 11.
- **Size.** 1,369 changed lines, under the 3,000-line bar: `engine.ts` +132 / -546, the new module +689, and the test 1 / 1.

## What stays in `engine.ts`

- Every moved method keeps its name, docblock, signature and position in the class, because tsup emits each member, private ones included, into the published `.d.ts`.

## The shape (slices 1 to 5)

- **The host interface.** `RunResumeHost` holds the 25 members these bodies read, each typed as the class member itself (`AutomationEngine['m']`), so a renamed member is a compile error. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
  - Each moved function types `this` as the `Pick` of `RunResumeHost` over exactly the members its own body reads, read off each body's AST in first-read order.
  - `creditChildRun` reads no member, so it is called directly, without a host.
- **Methods** are passed as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`, so a spy or test double set on the instance is still the one called. There are 17 of them:
  - `seedRunGrants`, `expandDeclaredLookups`, `refuseGatedResume`, `resumeInternal`, `resolveEffectiveSuspension` and `resolveSuspendedNodeType`;
  - `resolveResumeAuthority`, `resolveDeclaredResumeAuthority`, `resolveCanonicalDescriptor`, `loadSuspendedRunStrict` and `evictConsumedSuspension`;
  - `journalConsumedSuspension`, `forgetSuspendedRun`, `recordLog`, `claimAdvance`, `loadSuspendedRun` and `failSuspendedRun`.
- **Four fields go through a getter**, in slice 5's `store` form (#25223 cut 1, PR #25290), because a method reassigns each. The write sites are `engine.ts` at this head:
  - `store`: `setSuspendedRunStore` (`:2769`), and the constructor (`:2745`);
  - `userGrantsResolver`: `setUserGrantsResolver` (`:3988`);
  - `recordExpander`: `setRecordExpander` (`:3998`);
  - `nodeTypeVocabularySealed`: `sealNodeTypeVocabulary` (`:9424`).
  
  For each one, the stub builds `const readX = () => this.X;` and the host member `get X() { return readX(); }`. Each read in the body reads the engine's current value, as it did inside the class.
  - No moved body writes any field: the generator refuses a `this.X =`, `op=`, `++` or `--` in a moved body, and found none. So no get/set pair (#25508) is needed.
- **Four fields go by value**: `logger`, `suspendedRuns`, `cacheOnlySuspensions` and `consumedSuspensions`. The seat asked for proof that none is reassigned after construction:
  - The declarations (`engine.ts` at this head):
    - `private logger: Logger;`
    - `private suspendedRuns = new Map…`
    - `private cacheOnlySuspensions = new Set…`
    - `private consumedSuspensions = new Map…`
  - `git grep -nE "this\.(logger|suspendedRuns|cacheOnlySuspensions|consumedSuspensions)\s*=[^=]" -- packages/services/service-automation/src` finds 1 line, in the constructor: `this.logger = logger;` (`:2744`).
  - Across the repo, `git grep -nE "\.(suspendedRuns|cacheOnlySuspensions|consumedSuspensions)\s*(=[^=>]|\?\?=)"` finds nothing. The bracket form, `['logger']` and the other three names followed by `=` or `??=`, finds nothing either. And `git grep -nE "\.logger\s*(=[^=>]|\?\?=)" -- packages/services/service-automation` finds only that constructor line.
  - The bodies change the three collections' contents in place, on the engine's own `Map` and `Set`, and never rebind the fields.
- **Async.** The stubs of the twelve async methods drop `async` and return the moved function's promise, as in slices 3 to 5.
  - The caller gets the very promise the body makes.
  - Dropping `async` is the only edit to those signature lines, and the `.d.ts` does not print `async`.
- The moved bodies keep saying `this.`, so the moved lines are unedited.

## Module-level declarations and imports

- **Nothing is newly exported.** Every top-level name the bodies read is already exported from `engine.ts`: `buildRunTrigger`, `NodeExecutionResult`, `StepLogEntry` and `SuspendedRun`.
  - The module imports `buildRunTrigger` by value, and the rest, `AutomationEngine` included, as types.
  - `buildRunTrigger` is read only inside function bodies, at call time. A comment above the import says so, as in slices 3 and 5.
- **The module's other imports** use the same specifiers as `engine.ts`'s own imports:
  - the types `FlowParsed`, `FlowRunSummary`, `AutomationContext`, `AutomationResult` and `ResumeSignal`;
  - the values `RESUME_AUTHORITY_SERVICE` and `describeThrownForLog`;
  - the `./runtime-identity.js` and `./guard-refusal.js` import lines, verbatim. These are moved lines.
- **Two `engine.ts` import lines change.**
  - `./runtime-identity.js` keeps `runTriggerUserId` and `type SeededRunContext`. `runIsUnscopedUserMode`, `flowTouchesData` and `runOrgUserIds` were read only by moved bodies.
  - `import { refuseNode } from './guard-refusal.js';` goes, because only a moved body read `refuseNode`.
  - `engine.ts` gains the `./run-resume.js` import, after the `./run-history.js` one, with a 4-line comment naming its bodies.
- **Two imports stay, for their `{@link}`s.** `RESUME_AUTHORITY_SERVICE` and `SeededRunContext` are no longer read in `engine.ts` code, but `engine.ts` docblocks still `{@link}` them: 2 links each. `tsc` counts a `{@link}` as a use under `noUnusedLocals`, so both stay imported and the links still resolve.
  - A control re-added `validateScreenInputs` and `flowTouchesData`, which `engine.ts` neither reads nor links, to its imports. `tsc` failed with TS6133 on both. So the setting is live for this file.
- **Authored text.** The module docblock and the host interface's docblock are new. The host docblock names the method that reassigns each getter field.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved block.** This is `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change 03243fc6 HEAD` over `engine.ts` and `run-resume.ts`. It detects 534 of the 546 deleted lines and 582 of the 821 added lines as moved.
  - **Deleted, not moved (12):** the signature heads of the twelve async methods, each of which drops `async`.
  - **Added, not moved (239):**
    - the module's docblock, imports and host interface;
    - the fifteen pointer docblocks and rewritten function heads;
    - the `./run-resume.js` import and its comment, and the narrowed `./runtime-identity.js` import;
    - the twelve heads without `async`;
    - the fifteen stub bodies;
    - lines git does not pair with a moved block.
- **An independent check.** A script compared base and head `engine.ts` against the new module.
  - **Module lines.** 579 of the module's 689 lines are in 15 verbatim runs of base `engine.ts`: the fifteen method texts, de-indented one level. The script names each of the other 110:
    - 76 head lines: the copyright line, the docblock, the imports and their comment, the host docblock and the 25-member host interface;
    - the 15 pointer docblocks;
    - 19 signature lines: fifteen `export function` heads, and four `this` parameter lines, each a `Pick` of the host.
  - **Deleted lines.** Every line deleted from `engine.ts` (546 in all, 8 of them blank) is among the module's lines, apart from the 12 async heads above. The two deleted import lines are among them, verbatim.
  - **Added lines.** Of the 132 lines added to `engine.ts`, 101 are found nowhere in base. They are:
    - the narrowed `./runtime-identity.js` import;
    - the `./run-resume.js` import with its comment;
    - the twelve heads without `async`;
    - the stub lines.

    The other 31, such as `logger: this.logger,` and `};`, are lines base already contains elsewhere.
  - **Literals.** No string or template literal in the fifteen method bodies spans a line, checked on the TypeScript AST of base `engine.ts`. So de-indenting changed no string value.
- **`.d.ts`**: see the next section.
- **Bundles.** The ESM and CJS export lists are identical: 39 names each at base and at head, and ESM equals CJS on each side. The bundle JS bytes differ only because code moved within the bundle.
- **Tests.** `@objectstack/service-automation`'s suite passes the same at base and head, 199 of 199 files and 2628 of 2628 tests.

## `.d.ts` reading (ruling 6348891160, item 2)

The merge base is `03243fc6`, the head of `main`, so the merge-base reading and the base reading are one reading.

- **Base** is `dist/`, built at `03243fc6` in this container, in a worktree of that commit.
- **Head** is `dist/`, built at this PR's commit.
- The package's dependencies were built by `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/service-automation` (31 of 31 tasks), and both sides resolve the same built dependencies.

The readings:

- **Raw sha256**, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`, which are identical to each other on both sides: base `1a5162a4dd929399460a3936e22747a74cf0a8db24d398ffbab5d7ead7bf212e`, head `1a5162a4dd929399460a3936e22747a74cf0a8db24d398ffbab5d7ead7bf212e`.
- **Normalised sha256**, all four files: base `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`, head `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`.
- **Raw diff**, `index.d.ts` base vs head: **0 lines**, with 19,626 lines on each side. This slice reorders no union, so the normalised diff is empty too.
- **The normaliser**, the ruling's one-liner, verbatim:
  `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`
- **Positive controls**, on line 3583 of the head `index.d.ts`, a private member whose body moved. Each control changes that one line, then runs the same normaliser:
  - `private loadSuspendedRunStrict;` made public (`loadSuspendedRunStrict;`) gives `6218e57ef5778f6cd7830065199a40ae791e8f5948ce7ba5b329a19b77ef6aa3`.
  - The same member renamed (`private loadSuspendedRunStrictRenamed;`) gives `bc864cef7530af8f0921d14956e47c22a3d20aad6be293d6b494009cb1020c4e`.
  - Both differ from `0df32585…`, so the normaliser hides neither kind of change.
- **Item 1 holds:**
  - (a) the declaration set and visibility are the same;
  - (b) the files are byte-identical, before and after the normalisation;
  - (c) the ESM and CJS export lists are identical;
  - (d) there is no raw-diff line.

## Readers

**One reader re-pointed.** `src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`'s `ENGINE_SOURCES` holds the #10243 grep pins, which are absence checks. It gains `./run-resume.ts`, so a moved body is not a place the retired mechanism could come back unseen. That 1-line edit is the PR's third file.

**Readers examined.** The base for each is `03243fc6`, in a worktree of that commit.

- **`check-tenant-audit-census`** (derived): output byte-identical to base.
  - It certifies 238 write call sites (162 decidable; 2 provably without tenant context, 29 more unreadable).
  - It holds 23 prose figures and matches every `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row.
  - Its `--self-test` output is identical too.
- **`check-system-context-census`** (derived): output byte-identical. It finds 149 elevation read sites in 22 packages across 77 files, in 129 symbols.
- **`check:liveness`** (spec lane, not derived; run by hand as `packages/spec`'s `tsx scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts`): output byte-identical at base and head.
  - 753 (entry, cited file) pairs: 752 anchored, 1 exempt.
  - 982 of 982 symbol anchors resolve.
  - No `packages/spec/liveness` row cites any of the fifteen methods.
- **`check:platform-checklist`** (not derived; run by hand): output identical at base and head. 987 of 997 symbol anchors resolve; the other 10 are the same ones, the named #16898 residual.
- **`check-adr-symbol-anchors`** (not derived; run by hand): output identical at base and head. 2384 anchors across 142 records resolve.
- **`check:adr-anchors`** (decision letters; run by hand at the merge base and the head): output identical apart from the scanned-file count, 6691 at base and 6692 at head, the extra file being `run-resume.ts`.
  - It reads 84 anchored files, 52285 citations and 1947 decision-letter citations, the same at both ends.
  - Neither `engine.ts` nor `run-resume.ts` is on the anchored surface.
  - `docs/adr/0019-approval-as-flow-node.md` is not edited, and its "module-private" line about `ENGINE_BUILT_SIGNAL` stays true (see Scope).
- **`check:startup-registry-verdict`** (not derived; run by hand at both ends, on the hand-gate list): 46 seams, 40 of them read-only, none recording a verdict, at base and at head.
  - Its `--list` is the same at both ends apart from line numbers and the scanned-file count.
  - None of its four engine bodies moves.
  - The scanned file count is 3460 at base and 3461 at head; the extra file is `run-resume.ts`.
- **`path:line` citations.** The only one into this package's `engine.ts` is `service-automation/src/engine.ts:44`, in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/evidence.test.ts`. It is a realm-attribution fixture that `scanEvidence` parses without reading the file.
  - Lines of `engine.ts` from base `:68` to `:143` move up by 1. Lines after base `:143` move down by 20 until the first moved body.
  - Lines after the last moved body move up by 414, since the file goes from 11,108 to 10,694 lines.

## Gates

- **Derived.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this commit derives 60 families from the 3 changed paths: 1,369 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold.
  - All of them ran in this container on this commit, with each exit code captured before any pipe, and all 60 exit 0.
  - The run went in two parts. My own run limit stopped the first part during the 51st family, so that family and the 9 after it ran again in a second run. The 51st family's interrupted run is not counted.
  - `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles: 60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - The one family more than slice 5's 59 is `node scripts/ci/prune-turbo-cache.mjs --self-test`, which #25523 added to `main`.
- **By hand, at base and head, not derived:** `check:liveness`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:adr-anchors` and `check:startup-registry-verdict`, with the readings in the Readers section above.
- **Package checks.**
  - `@objectstack/service-automation`'s `vitest run` gives 199 of 199 files and 2628 of 2628 tests, the same at base and head.
  - The package's `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`) passes.
  - ESLint on the three files passes.
- **Open PRs**, re-listed just before this PR was opened: 11. I diffed each one's head against its merge base with `origin/main`. None of them touches `service-automation/src`, the readers above, their ledgers, or `docs/adr/0019-approval-as-flow-node.md`.
  - #25545 edits `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`, but only its `plugin-security` rows.
  - The Version Packages PR #24876 touches only the package's `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`.
  - `main` has moved to `9c43e19f` (#25436, a `scripts/pm` queue guard, and #25562, release notes), which touches none of these files.

## Acceptance notes

- The slice is the slice-6 group the remaining-bodies table named, less `refuseInvalidScreenInput` and `buildSubflowResumeSignal`. Those two stay so that ADR-0019's "module-private" line about `ENGINE_BUILT_SIGNAL` stays true. The claim says so.
- Four host getters, in the slice-5 `store` form. No get/set pair is needed.
- No `export` is added to `engine.ts`.
- After this slice, about 815 movable lines in bodies over 3 lines are left for slice 7, and they need no ruling. The 21 site-bearing bodies, and the five startup-registry bodies tied to `registerFlow`, wait on the 33-site ruling.
